brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Build provides shelf surfaces via covers at 0,0,1;full;top and 0,1,1;full;top on stacked pieces (0,0,0/1 and 0,1,0/1) forming two shelf levels. However per system instructions, this checks fit not strength and load ratings cannot be claimed or verified - no part is rated to 50 kg in the configurator, check_build only validates geometry/meshClash=clear.
Two notch drawer frames installed: notch:0#-1,1#notch0 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf at level 0) and notch:1#-1,1#notch0 (level 1) between the stacked columns, providing two pull-out drawers.

finish.summary: Built a two-level stacked shelf unit (4x full hex bases at 0,0,0/1 and 0,1,0/1 with top covers as shelf surfaces, meshClash clear) with two notch drawer frames at -1,1 level 0 and 1. Cannot claim 50 kg load rating as the system explicitly does not verify structural strength.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
